post.summary: Add a Line by buying or porting a number
post.description: Owner and Admin only. A port is `porting` until the carrier completes it. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe: the same key with the same request answers 200 with the first Line and buys or ports nothing again, for 24 hours.

schema.description: A client-chosen key. The same key with the same request returns the first Line and does nothing again, for 24 hours; the same key with another request is request.idempotency_key_reused (422); the same key while the first request is still running is request.idempotency_in_progress (409, with Retry-After). Without it the call is not protected against being repeated.

parameters.description: A client-chosen key. The same key with the same request returns the first Line and does nothing again, for 24 hours; the same key with another request is request.idempotency_key_reused (422); the same key while the first request is still running is request.idempotency_in_progress (409, with Retry-After). Without it the call is not protected against being repeated.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

200.description: The Line this Idempotency-Key created earlier; nothing was bought or ported.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired or not valid.

409.description: line.number_unavailable, or request.idempotency_in_progress while the first request with this Idempotency-Key is still running (send it again after Retry-After).

schema.description: Whole seconds to wait before trying again.

post.summary: Mint a softphone token for the caller
post.description: Any role. The token lets the caller's browser register as a softphone. It is short-lived (15 minutes), names only the caller's Membership and Organization, and is never cached: ask again before `expiresAt`.

403.description: auth.forbidden: the caller has no Membership in the Organization.

500.description: Something went wrong on our side.

503.description: server.unavailable: the telephony provider is not available.

post.summary: Place a Call to a Prospect
post.description: Any voice role. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key with the same request places one Call and answers 200 with it, for 24 hours. The Disclosure plays before the Rep is bridged and before the recording starts, on every Call; there is no setting for it. A Contact Check denial is a warning on the placed Call, never a refusal.

200.description: The Call this Idempotency-Key placed earlier; nothing was dialled again.

201.description: The Call, `live` once the Disclosure has played and the Rep is bridged.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired or not valid.

409.description: call.line_unavailable, or request.idempotency_in_progress while the first request with this Idempotency-Key is still running (send it again after Retry-After).

schema.description: Whole seconds to wait before trying again.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before trying again.

422.description: call.number_invalid, or request.idempotency_key_reused: the key was used for another request.

500.description: Something went wrong on our side.

502.description: call.disclosure_failed: the Disclosure did not play; the Call failed.

503.description: server.unavailable: the telephony provider did not answer.
